newsitem.title: USA: New York City sets big bond sale for Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: New York City sets big bond sale for Nov 6.

text.p: New York City, one of the biggest issuers in the municipal market, plans to sell almost $1 billion of new money and refunding debt on Nov 6, a New York City official said Thursday.
The official, who declined to be named, explained that the new money portion of the sale includes around $400 million of tax-exempt bonds and about $100 million of taxable debt.

The refunding section now is estimated at about $422 million of tax-exempt bonds and around $72 million of taxable bonds, although the official said these amounts have shifted slightly and might again be readjusted.
Bear, Steans & Co earlier was selected to senior manage the syndicate for the negotiated part of the offering.

New York City, which in June made its first foray into European markets when it sold a $180 million Eurobond in London, is seeking bidders from around the world for as much as $172 million of taxable new money and refunding bonds.
"(The taxable issue) could go anywhere," the official said, adding "The whole idea is to leave it completely open, that way we get the best price."
